reviews.text: The service was great.

We didn't have a dog groomer, and while searching online, we discovered Doggos Spa. We saw they had already groomed several golden retrievers, and we saw photos of other dogs with excellent results and great reviews, so we decided to give it a try. We went, and they saw us right away. We were delighted with the results, especially with the fantastic job they did on our dog, as he hadn't been to the groomer in a while and had quite a lot of matted hair. We'll be back!

I took my dog ​​in; his hair was very matted and long. I couldn't get an appointment anywhere at this time of year, and they did a perfect job—he looked like a teddy bear! I'm very happy with them and highly recommend them. I'm so grateful, as I don't usually brush my dog's hair, and they still managed to cut it beautifully.
I love the way they treat me and how gorgeous they make my dog ​​look. Plus, the app for managing appointments is fantastic. I recommend them 100%! 👍 …
My experience was great, they treated my pet very well and she looked beautiful like a princess

I just took my dog ​​in. I told them how I wanted the cut, they took the time to ask me a few questions to make sure it turned out exactly as I wanted, and they did a spectacular job! Exactly how I wanted it! Very kind and professional. Nana will definitely be one of their clients from now on! She looks gorgeous! 😍 …
First time using it and I couldn't be happier, highly recommended. 👌🏽 …

On June 22, 2023, we took our rabbit to this establishment for a grooming service.

When we picked him up and got home, we were shocked. Before the visit, he was an active animal and walked normally. After returning from the establishment, he could no longer walk at all. He tried to move around using only his front paws, while one of his hind legs dragged weakly behind him.

We immediately went to the vet. There, we were informed that he had a severe dislocated leg. From that moment on, the consultations, treatment, and every possible attempt to help him began.

During the following weeks, we did everything we could to save him. However, despite our efforts and the veterinary care, our rabbit passed away on July 9, 2023.

I can't say exactly what happened during the service because I wasn't present. But the fact is that we took a rabbit to this establishment that was walking on its own and returned home with an animal that could no longer walk.

I live in the building next door. Every time I walk past this place, I remember this story and the pain it caused our family.

After this experience, I will never again entrust any of my animals to this establishment.
Had our chihuahua in for a nail trim and a bath. He smelled wonderful and his nails looked good.
I love bringing my dog ​​here, the service is excellent.

We’re traveling through Europe, from Australia, with our cocker spaniel. He was badly in need of a groom and we found Doggo’s Spa to be excellent! Even though I don’t speak Spanish the staff were patient and translated with me. I couldn’t be happier with our boys haircut, and the excellent service we received.

I'm very happy with Doggo's Spa. They took great care of my dog, who is usually difficult to groom, and made her look lovely. Although they couldn't finish the treatment completely because she wouldn't let them, I'm grateful for the staff's patience and kindness.

I took my dog ​​and they just happened to have an opening, which was great because they attended to him right away. They asked me how I wanted his hair cut and did it exactly as I asked. I've included a photo so you can see how handsome he looked. I'm very happy with both the service and the result. Plus, the place is beautiful, which is always a plus! We'll definitely be back!
very attentive and professional
A great experience! My dog ​​left very happy and looking very handsome. The staff is very friendly 😊 We'll definitely be back! …
They took great care of Mustang and left him smelling amazing 🤍 …

Very bad.
In my case, the same thing happened as the previous negative reviewer. I had an appointment, and when I arrived, they didn't want to take my dog ​​because she had knots.
I have an 11-month-old poodle, and her hair is super fine and woolly. It's true that even though I brush her, I probably don't brush her very well (since I don't do it professionally, like the so-called professionals at this place).
That's why I took her to this place, so they, as professionals, could help me with the knots that get more tangled.
They told me the same thing: that I didn't brush my dog ​​and that you couldn't see her skin because of the knots.
What a coincidence! Two poodles, who are clearly well cared for, and the reason they didn't want to treat them is because of us, the owners.
What you are is unprofessional.
And if you don't want to remove knots from the little ones, you can do something else. I absolutely do NOT recommend this place.
The care my baby received was wonderful!! 1000% recommended! ✨✨
I love how my poodle's hair always looks.
I am delighted with them, they always make her look beautiful, and my dog ​​Nala is very happy. I have been taking Nala there since they opened and they have always treated me wonderfully.

It was actually the first time I took my poodle there because it was nearby, and the experience was very positive. I honestly told them I wanted him to look like the one in the picture they had in a frame, and... magic! He came out looking so handsome, even with a Christmas scarf, he practically had a girlfriend! 😍 Thanks to the Doggo's team; they knew exactly what they were looking for. See you soon. Happy holidays!

I'm giving it fewer stars because I can't. The fact that this place calls itself a dog grooming salon is a disgrace. What they did to my dog ​​is outrageous. He's a one-and-a-half-year-old poodle. I've attached photos from a few days before and after showing the disaster they created. According to them, he had knots, and they literally told us, "Either we cut his hair very short, or you take him." Excuse me?! What kind of service do you offer? Such a lack of professionalism! I can't say anything more, shameless. I could have done it myself without any training, because there's a difference between cutting the hair short and what they did to him, which is beyond repair. All this just to avoid untangling knots they didn't even try to remove. But wait, when you book, it seems like they offer a knot-untangling service... MEOW. They've truly left my partner and me very upset. Right in the middle of the Christmas holidays... UNBELIEVABLE. I will never go back, and what's more, it's not that I won't recommend it, it's that I'm going to recommend that nobody take their pet there.

AWFUL, I absolutely do not recommend them. We took our dog in for a trim and they treated him so badly he looked sick. What a disaster and so unprofessional. They called us to let us know he had mats, but we never expected them to do such a terrible thing and shave him completely bald. I highly doubt they could have saved his fur with a little patience. We will not be returning; we are very disappointed with the service.
My Cavalier looks gorgeous and amazing! We'll be back!
I loved the haircut and, most importantly, the service I received 😃 Thank you …
Very professional and attentive
The ideal place

Thanks for your reply. I find it disrespectful that you say he doesn't know what a comb or water is. Second, yes, it arrived with knots, but you said you were going to try to untangle it, right? And that the cut would be short, right? Unfortunately for you, "short" means leaving it bald. And you think his eyebrows are fine? Anyway, thanks.

Camila and Lindy are so kind and caring to us. Coco is so happy when he comes to the groomer. They are definitely the best in all of Valencia. I don't live nearby, but I come all the way here just because they make him look gorgeous and they love him so much 😍✨ …

Very good service experience and my dogs haircut looks awesome! ! I appreciative her for making room for my dog even though I made a scheduling error and booked for a different date and time. You can tell she loves working with dogs and dogs love her because my dog normally doesn’t let anyone touch her right foot but she was able to do it with no problem.
Highly recommend, just make sure you select  the correct date and time 😉
Excellent service! They work very well with huskies!
I love the attention Camila and Lindy give to my dogs.
The service was spectacular, highly recommended 10/10.

This is the second time I've been to this dog groomer and I'll NEVER go back. The first time, they left my dog's bottom covered in poop. I called them when I got home and noticed, and their response was that they had washed it twice… a lie.

The second time was last Wednesday, five days ago, and when I took him back, I asked them to wash his bottom again, and everything seemed fine. I went to pick up my dog ​​(a German Shepherd, and they charged me €40.50 for Black Friday, but it's normally €45), and everything seemed fine, but then they told me he was trying to bite the hairdryer… something my dog ​​has NEVER done at any other groomer, so I thought it was strange. My dog, starting the day of his grooming appointment, refused to brush, developed red rashes and sores, and was trembling and lethargic… SOLUTION: I took him to the vet, and he had MOIST DERMATITIS because they hadn't dried him properly, even though German Shepherds have two coats and need to be dried very, very thoroughly. He had pain all over his back, which is why he was trembling from the pain! I don't know how much force they used to dry or brush him for the animal to have such severe back pain! He's on antibiotics and anti-inflammatories for a week, and from now on, he'll be on chondroprotective agents for the pain. Please don't take your pet there. The Colombian girl was the one who left the poop on his bottom, and the redhead was the one who caused the dermatitis and back pain.

Edited review: They think they know more than the veterinarians themselves, and on top of that, they're liars. I didn't say my dog ​​had dermatitis, and I never complained about the price; I only mentioned it. I spoke about the bottom issue with that Colombian girl, who was just an outsider, so if she wants to act smart about what's going on inside, that's her business, not mine. And of course, I'm posting this review so that anyone who loves their pet will never take them to this place (at least if they're a German Shepherd, Golden Retriever, etc.). If you think it's defaming your business, do a better job and don't try to be more right than a veterinarian. Shameless!
Excellent service, 100% recommended

Highly recommended.
